text:
Predicates:
EconHardship(x) ::: x has economic hardship.
FinancialAid(x, y) ::: x receives financial aid for y.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
FamilySingleParent(x) ::: x is from a single-parent family.
OutOfWorkForLong(x) ::: x's parent has been out of work for more than a year.
GRE(y) ::: y is the GRE test.
Applicant(x, y) ::: x is an applicant for y.
Cost(y, amount) ::: y costs amount dollars.
ProvidesAid(organization, x, y) ::: organization provides aid to x for y.
LivesInFamily(x, y) ::: x lives in family y.
FamilyHasFinancialHardship(x) ::: x's family has financial hardship.
Premises:
Cost(GRE, 205) ::: It costs US $205 to take the GRE test.
ProvidesAid(ETS, x, GRE) ← ProveHardship(x) ::: ETS provides financial aid to those who prove hardship.
FamilySingleParent(tom) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
OutOfWorkForLong(tom'sFather) ::: Tom's dad has been out of work for more than a year.
Conclusion:
∃x (Applicant(x, GRE) ∧ ProveHardship(x)) ::: Tom can apply for financial aid from ETS to take the GRE test.
